title: Nirvāṇa Ṣaṭkam
author: Ādi Śaṅkarācārya
intro: Six verses by Ādi Śaṅkarācārya on the nature of the Self, also called Ātma-ṣaṭkam. Each verse says what the Self is not, and ends with the same refrain: cid-ānanda-rūpaḥ śivo 'haṃ śivo 'ham, 'my form is consciousness and bliss; I am Shiva'.
note: Written in Bhujaṅgaprayāta, 'the serpent's gait': four groups of light-heavy-heavy (◡ — —) per line. Word cards for the refrain are given in verse 1.
